limitations: M1 is funded by SPOT closes only: there is no perp leg, so the position is long-only spot and the return is a directional bet, not a delta-neutral carry. Costs are charged on rebalance days only, which understates the true round trip of an illiquid exit.
M2 measures the CHANGE IN FUNDING, not the funding payment itself, so it is a reversal bet on the rate and not the carry. The realised payment is not counted.
Both are HISTORICAL descriptions with no out-of-sample claim; DEV/EVAL is a time split, not a forecast.

The new gates G1/G2 are tail metrics, not a substitute for t: a strategy can pass G1 with a negative median. G2 (median >= 0) is reported but the gate set above does not include it — recorded rather than silently added.

M1.name: M1 trend-on-illiquid (200 smallest above $50k/day, 40d lookback, 90d rebalance)

M2.name: M2 funding-extremum reversal (30d trailing deciles, 30d rebalance)
